caption: The drawing depicts a full-body statue of a man standing on a rectangular base. The man has brown skin and is dressed in traditional attire featuring a tan or light brown tunic with fringed edges, a sash across his body, and decorated leggings. He has ornamental bands around his upper arms and a necklace with a large central pendant. On his head, he wears a feathered headdress with brown, red, and beige feathers. He holds a long object, possibly a staff or club, diagonally across his chest with his right hand while his left arm hangs at his side. The statue stands on a green and brown mottled platform suggesting grass or stone. The background is a plain, off-white color with no other objects or scenery visible. The artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Wooden Indian
